## ✅ Step 2 Complete — Desktop App Skeleton & Automated Testing Foundation

**116 tests pass (0 failures).**

### What was built:

**🖥️ Desktop Main Process** (`src/main.mjs`)
- Electron BrowserWindow with `contextIsolation: true`, `nodeIntegration: false`, `sandbox: true`
- Lockfile polling (3s interval) with LCU auto-discovery across Windows/WSL paths
- LCU connection lifecycle: lockfile → client → WebSocket bridge → IPC handler registration
- Credential-safe logger: `password/token/secret/authorization` masked in all output

**🔒 Restricted Renderer** (`src/preload.mjs`, `src/renderer/`)
- Preload script exposes typed `window.lcuApi` via `contextBridge` — no Node.js/Electron access
- 18 typed IPC methods + 4 event subscriptions (gameflow, champselect, connection, error)
- Minimal dark UI with 3 panels (Ally Score, Counter, Rune) and live connection status

**🧩 Adapter Layer** (new modules)
- `src/lcu/lcuClient.mjs` — LCU REST client with scoped HTTPS agent (self-signed cert only for 127.0.0.1), `sanitiseResponse()` strips credential fields
- `src/lcu/wsBridge.mjs` — WebSocket event bridge with auto-reconnect and typed callbacks
- `src/stats/matchHistory.mjs` — Cached fetcher with 3s TTL, max 2 concurrency, graceful degradation
- `src/opgg/counterCache.mjs` — OP.GG counter data reader with patch staleness detection
- `src/opgg/runeMapper.mjs` — OP.GG → LCU PerkPage payload mapper with 9-item validation

**🔀 Feature Orchestrators** (new modules)
- `src/features/allyScorer.mjs` — Coordinates ranked-stats + match-history → horse grade per ally
- `src/features/counterAdvisor.mjs` — Advises on champion matchups from cached OP.GG data
- `src/features/runeInjector.mjs` — Maps → validates → POSTs rune pages with error handling

**📡 Typed IPC** (`src/ipc/`)
- `channels.mjs` — 21 named channel constants in Set for validation
- `ipcRouter.mjs` — Factory-pattern handler map, wraps all with `{ok, data, error}` envelope

**🧪 Testing Foundation**
- 14 test files: all existing (5) + new (9) covering lcuClient, wsBridge, matchHistory, counterCache, runeMapper, ipcRouter, allyScorer, counterAdvisor, runeInjector, plus communication integration and fixture validation
- 7 fixture files: lockfile, champselect session, ranked stats, match history, WS events, OP.GG counter, valid perk payload, fault scenarios
- `test/communication.test.mjs` validates credential safety, directory structure, import chain, and preload API shape

**⚙️ DevOps**
- `eslint.config.mjs` — flat config for ESM
- `.github/workflows/test.yml` — CI: `npm ci` → `npm run lint` → `npm test`
- `.gitignore` — excludes node_modules, .env, logs, dist
- `package.json` — updated with `start`, `dev`, `test`, `test:coverage`, `lint` scripts; `ws` dependency, `electron` + `eslint` devDeps
